title: 第7章 引气入体第8章 炼气一层
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 唐落天也是多灵根，修行之中自然发现了那些杂气，每每需要花大量时间将它排出体外，这是所有多灵根的做法，也是他们修炼比单灵根慢的原因，毕竟单灵根修炼只需不停吸收，他们却要吐纳。
“入定看的是悟性，引气入体看的是体质，与灵根无关，现在看来她悟性很高，就不知道体质如何了。”
掌门最后唏嘘道。
听到这，唐落天迷惑了，“但是以往，许多五灵根师弟师妹入定和引气入体就是比单灵根双灵根的人慢很多。”
“难道单灵根的人就都悟性生来高，体质生来好吗？这怎么会与灵根无关？”
掌门看向他，无奈道，“世人听到五灵根第一反应都是贬低丧气，听到单灵根则都是喜悦自信，这样的心态差别之下，若是悟性平庸的人，自然会呈现出截然不同的效果。”
“就是悟性高的人，怀着不自信，丧气的心态也会心浮气躁，难以入定，你可明白？”
唐落天恍然大悟，原来是这样。
“所以你小师妹悟性高，却有着灵根累赘，更是可惜。”
掌门人虽然年轻时游历四方，见识颇有门道，可他也想不出能解决多灵根这个千古难题的办法，只能心里直叹气。
若是悟性差一辈子庸庸碌碌也就罢了，偏偏悟性高，只怕这小女孩要被自己的聪慧反噬，痛苦与日俱增了。
这样想着，掌门也不再关注巫未央了，省得看得自己心疼惋惜，影响了自己的心志。
唐落天倒是一直看着，他是金水木三灵根，在朝天宗这个小宗门里算是资质好的，入定和引气入体都花了三个月，这样曾经也得到掌门的夸赞，而现在巫未央眼看着一天就入定，说不定引气入体也很快了。
屋里的巫未央并没有听到掌门和唐落天的对话，入定状态时，外界一切都隔绝了。
她眼前依旧是那些五彩斑斓的光团。
有了上一次的教训，这一次巫未央心里很平静，没有再因为激动而掉出入定状态。
观察了光团半天，巫未央有点想触碰这些光团，可手却动不了，而光团只是绕着她飘浮并没有靠近的意思。
要如何触碰呢？
因为没有想到巫未央一天就能入定，唐落天还没给她讲解如何吸引灵气，纳入体内。
巫未央盯着光团发呆了半天，忽然意识她现在好像只有一双眼睛，没有身体，难怪手伸不起来。
她感觉自己只有一双眼睛后就开始以各种角度看去，新奇的视野让她感到有趣。
这时，她终于发现了视野下方形似一棵树的亮光。
那是由五种颜色的光绳凝聚的，头部和尾部则分叉开，这也是巫未央觉得它像是树一样的原因。
巫未央想起炼气诀，意识到这可能就是她的灵根。
灵根和灵气共鸣就能引气入体。
但怎么共鸣？巫未央又陷入了沉思。
不过这次，她只起了共鸣的念头，灵根的光芒就微微变亮了一些，然后光团好像被灵根的亮光吸引，开始慢慢靠近。
巫未央一喜，仔细感觉过后，她觉得自己似乎变成了灵根，一呼一吸，灵根的亮光便一亮一暗。
她控制着亮光闪烁，如同召唤一般，让周围的光团都加速靠近。
但光团却都在灵根不远处停了下来，像是被什么挡住了。
巫未央不解，加快了亮光闪烁，然而光团急得团团转也进不来。
content_en:
Tang Luotian also has multiple spiritual roots. He naturally discovered those impurities during his practice, and it often takes a lot of time to expel them from the body. This is what all multiple spiritual roots do, and it is also the reason why their cultivation is slower than that of single spiritual roots. After all, single spiritual root cultivation only requires constant absorption, but they have to breathe out.
"Entering samadhi depends on one's understanding. Introducing Qi into one's body depends on one's physical constitution, and it has nothing to do with spiritual roots. Now it seems that her understanding is very high, so I don't know what her physical condition is like."
The leader finally sighed.
Hearing this, Tang Luotian was confused, "But in the past, many junior brothers and sisters with five spiritual roots entered concentration and introduced Qi into the body much slower than those with single spiritual roots and double spiritual roots."
"Does it mean that people with only spiritual roots are born with high understanding and good physique? How could this have nothing to do with spiritual roots?"
The leader looked at him and said helplessly, "When people in the world hear the five spiritual roots, their first reaction is to belittle and feel discouraged. When they hear the single spiritual roots, they are happy and confident. With this difference in mentality, if you are a person with mediocre understanding, you will naturally have completely different effects."
"Even people with high levels of understanding can become restless and find it difficult to enter concentration if they are not confident and have a depressed attitude. Do you understand?"
Tang Luotian suddenly realized that this was the case.
"So it's a pity that your junior sister has a high level of understanding but has a burdensome spiritual root."
Although the leader traveled around the world when he was young and was quite knowledgeable, he could not think of a way to solve the eternal problem of Duolinggen, so he could only sigh in his heart.
If she had poor understanding, she would be mediocre for the rest of her life, but if she had high understanding, I'm afraid this little girl would be backlashed by her own intelligence, and her pain would increase day by day.
Thinking of this, the leader no longer paid attention to Wu Weiyang, so as not to make him feel distressed and regretful, which would affect his own ambition.
Tang Luotian kept watching. He had the three spiritual roots of Jin, Shui and Mu. He was considered to be very qualified in the small sect of Chaotian Sect. It took three months to enter meditation and introduce the Qi into the body. He had been praised by the leader in the past. But now Wu Weiyang was able to enter concentration in just one day. Maybe the introduction of Qi into the body was also very fast.
Wu Weiyang in the room did not hear the conversation between the leader and Tang Luotian. When he entered a state of trance, everything outside was cut off.
In front of her eyes were still those colorful light groups.
With the lesson learned from the last time, Wu Weiyang felt very calm this time and did not fall out of trance due to excitement.
After observing the light groups for a long time, Wu Weiyang wanted to touch these light groups, but her hands could not move. The light groups just floated around her and showed no intention of getting closer.
How to touch it?
Because she didn't expect that Wu Weiyang could enter samadhi in one day, Tang Luotian hadn't explained to her how to attract spiritual energy and incorporate it into her body.
Wu Weiyang stared at the light ball in a daze for a long time, and suddenly realized that she seemed to have only one pair of eyes and no body. No wonder she couldn't stretch her hands.
She felt that since she had only one pair of eyes, she began to see from various angles, and the novel vision made her feel interesting.
At this time, she finally spotted a light that looked like a tree in the lower part of her field of vision.
It was condensed by five colors of light ropes, and the head and tail were bifurcated. This is why Wu Weiyang felt that it looked like a tree.
Wu Weiyang thought of the Qi Refining Technique and realized that this might be her spiritual root.
Resonance between spiritual roots and spiritual energy can lead to energy entering the body.
But how to resonate? Wu Weiyang fell into deep thought again.
But this time, she only had the thought of resonance, and the light of the spiritual root became slightly brighter. Then the light group seemed to be attracted by the bright light of the spiritual root and began to approach slowly.
Wu Weiyang was overjoyed. After feeling it carefully, she felt as if she had become a spiritual root. Every time she breathed in, the light of the spiritual root would light up and dim.
She controlled the flash of bright light, like a summons, causing the surrounding light groups to accelerate closer.
But the light groups stopped not far from the spiritual root, as if they were blocked by something.
Wu Weiyang was puzzled and sped up the light flashing, but the light group was so anxious that it couldn't get in.
